name: Refero Styles
summary: Library of 2,000+ AI-readable DESIGN.md style records from real product websites, with colors, typography and spacing.
description: Refero Styles (beta) turns real product websites into AI-readable style records: each style has screenshots, color roles, typography, spacing and component notes, plus a DESIGN.md export to use in AI coding tools. Styles are grouped into collections such as dashboards, landing pages, pricing pages, API docs, dark mode and brand-matching prompts, with guides on writing DESIGN.md.
contains: 2,000+ AI-readable design systems from product websites
each style: screenshots, colors, typography, spacing, components and a DESIGN.md export
collections for dashboards, pricing pages, landing pages, API docs, forms and settings
styles captured from sites like Vercel, Linear, Raycast, Notion and Figma
